items.stem: Why is an active-learning loop valuable in experimental materials discovery?

options.text: It chooses the most informative experiments next, reducing the number needed to find good materials
options.rationale: Correct: active learning targets experiments that most improve the model.

options.text: It removes the need to ever run experiments
options.rationale: It guides experiments; it does not eliminate them.

options.text: It guarantees the first candidate will be optimal
options.rationale: It improves efficiency, not a guarantee of optimality.

options.text: It only works without any model
options.rationale: Active learning relies on a model to rank candidate experiments.

items.explanation: Correct: active learning targets experiments that most improve the model.

items.stem: Which TWO issues most threaten a materials machine-learning study's validity? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Data leakage between training and test sets

options.rationale: Correct: biased data yields models that fail to generalise.

options.text: Using version control for the analysis code
options.rationale: Version control helps reproducibility; it is not a threat.
